name: manual_f9911f
claim: When adding a new validation/deny check to an existing multi-branch security gate, insert it AFTER the pre-existing allow/deny decision, not before -- ordering changes which error code fires for already-covered cases and can silently break passing tests.

decisions.notes: Added an HTTPS-required-for-non-loopback check ahead of the existing allowRemoteLlm/host-allowlist check in endpoint-policy.ts's validateAndPin(). This flipped the thrown error code (scheme_disallowed instead of non_loopback_denied) for the plain deny-by-default case, breaking 3 previously-passing tests. Only caught because the full test suite was re-run immediately after applying the diff -- a diff/plan document should never be trusted as correct without a full build+test pass against the live code.
